# Tondok

Tondok is a social media scheduler for creators and agencies. This plugin connects Antigravity to your Tondok
workspaces so the agent can:

- See your workspaces, connected social accounts, media library and posts.
- Import a video or image from a link (direct, Dropbox or Google Drive), or upload a file from your computer, into
  your media library.
- Write posts for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and Threads at once, with per-platform options, and check
  what still blocks publishing (aspect ratio, video length, missing YouTube title or TikTok privacy).
- Schedule posts or publish now, then report the live links or errors per account.

## Sign in

After installing, open **Customizations → Installed → MCP Servers** and click **Authenticate** next to Tondok. Sign
in to tondok.com, tick the workspaces Antigravity may use and pick its access level: read only, drafts and media, or
full (schedule and publish). You can revoke access at any time in Tondok under **Settings → AI access**.

Requires a Tondok account with at least one connected social account. Create one at https://tondok.com.
